description: Settings window (SwiftUI via NSHostingController, 3 tabs: Gesture, Behavior, About) with trackpad preview, and menu bar 'Settings...' item
steps: Create Sources/Ledge/SettingsWindow.swift - NSWindow subclass or factory that creates a titled, closable, non-resizable window (~500x400) hosting an NSHostingController with SettingsView as root. Pattern similar to DiagnosticsWindow.swift but using NSHostingController. Window is isReleasedWhenClosed = false so it can be reopened. Include a show() method.

Create Sources/Ledge/SettingsView.swift - Root SwiftUI view with TabView(.automatic style) containing 3 tabs: GestureSettingsTab, BehaviorSettingsTab, AboutTab. Uses an @Observable SettingsViewModel class that reads/writes Preferences and calls a closure to trigger applyPreferences().

Create Sources/Ledge/GestureSettingsTab.swift - Gesture tab containing: TrackpadPreviewView at top, edge width slider (range 0.01-0.10, step 0.005, displays fraction and approximate mm), activation distance slider, fine control toggle, swap sides toggle. All bound to the SettingsViewModel.

Create Sources/Ledge/TrackpadPreviewView.swift - SwiftUI View showing a 3:2 aspect ratio rounded rectangle representing the trackpad with left/right edge bands as semi-transparent blue overlays. Width updates live from slider. Shows numeric mm labels. Labels 'Brightness' on left, 'Volume' on right (swap when swapSides is on). Subtle border for trackpad texture.

Create Sources/Ledge/BehaviorSettingsTab.swift - Behavior tab with: enabled toggle, cursor freeze toggle, continuous volume (no HUD) toggle, typing lockout slider (0.2-2.0s), bottom quarter only toggle, gesture timeout slider, launch at login toggle.

Create Sources/Ledge/AboutTab.swift - About tab with: app icon (NSApp icon), version string from Bundle.main, description 'Ledge - trackpad edge gestures for volume & brightness', link to GitHub repo.

Modify Sources/Ledge/MenuBarController.swift - Add 'Settings...' menu item with keyEquivalent ',' (Cmd+,) before the Diagnostics item. Add an `onShowSettings: (() -> Void)?` callback similar to onShowDiagnostics.

Modify Sources/Ledge/AppDelegate.swift - Create and own a SettingsWindow instance. Wire menuBar.onShowSettings to show the settings window. Pass a reference/closure so SettingsWindow can call controller.applyPreferences() when settings change.

MenuBarController has 'Settings...' item with Cmd+, shortcut

Changes apply immediately via applyPreferences() closure
